{"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","response":{"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","responseId":"X9OKaazDBZKymtkP8ZbhgAU","candidates":[{"finishReason":"STOP","index":0,"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n\n  // Preserve stable mode behavior (Reluctant Doubling)\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 1: Retrieve current fast and slow LBD averages\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Maintain a persistent circular buffer (size 10)\n  // Using static variables to maintain state across calls without modifying struct\n  static double buffer[10];\n  static int head = 0;\n  static bool initialized = false;\n\n  if (!initialized)\n    {\n      for (int i = 0; i \u003c 10; i++)\n        buffer[i] = fast;\n      initialized = true;\n    }\n\n  // Calculate gradient (current - oldest)\n  // The value at 'head' is the oldest value in the buffer (from 10 updates ago)\n  const double oldest = buffer[head];\n  const double gradient = fast - oldest;\n\n  // Update buffer\n  buffer[head] = fast;\n  head = (head + 1) % 10;\n\n  // Step 3: Calculate dynamic margin M'\n  // Base margin M\n  const double M = (100.0 + GET_OPTION (restartmargin)) / 100.0;\n  \n  // Dynamic margin M' = M - (gradient * 2.0)\n  double M_prime = M - (gradient * 2.0);\n\n  // Step 4: Clamp M' to [0.8, 1.5]\n  if (M_prime \u003c 0.8)\n    M_prime = 0.8;\n  if (M_prime \u003e 1.5)\n    M_prime = 1.5;\n\n  // Step 5: Trigger restart if avg_fast \u003e avg_slow * M'\n  const double limit = slow * M_prime;\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart gradient %g M' %.2f limit %g fast %g\",\n                            gradient, M_prime, limit, fast);\n\n  return (fast \u003e limit);\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}]}}],"usageMetadata":{"thoughtsTokenCount":8651,"totalTokenCount":15082,"promptTokenCount":5855,"candidatesTokenCount":576,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":5855}]}},"key":"req-0001"}
